mechanism: Eslicarbazepine is a CYP3A4 inducer that may increase metabolism of infliximab and reduce its therapeutic levels, while infliximab as a TNF-alpha inhibitor increases infection risk which may be compounded by eslicarbazepine use in immunocompromised patients.
action: Monitor infliximab efficacy closely; consider therapeutic drug monitoring of infliximab levels and watch for signs of reduced efficacy or increased infection risk during concurrent use.
